summary: Iter635 Paket38 — Webhook HMAC-SHA256 signature (sign/rotate/verify + docs), Public API v1 usage series + anomaly detection (25 calls today → factor>3 with 7g ort 0), Booking chain-search geo (centre_km + walk_min + station + airport ~9km via Photon, cached), PMS Sync Alerts (config CRUD, simulate triggers with mocked emails, already_open dedupe, mocked push does NOT resolve, disabled short-circuit, unknown provider 404, timeline health=degraded with failed_entries). Backend: 23/23 pytest PASSED. Frontend: /book-all shows chain-geo-{pid} rows with 📍 Merkez + 🚉 Aldgate + ✈ London City Airport 9.1 km (matches spec). Super Admin PA Keys: pa-key-chart toggles pa-key-usage-chart-{id}; pa-webhook-sig-toggle reveals pa-webhook-sig-doc containing HMAC-SHA256 python/node snippets. PMS Sync UI banner/config verified via backend API (open=1, degraded, failed_entries=12) — could not reach panel via automation because Aldgate branch switch + sidebar 'pms-connect-btn' is nested/collapsed.

integration_issues.issue: PmsConnectHub uses activePropertyId which falls back to properties[0].id when 'All Branches' is selected; users viewing hub without explicit branch selection see Franziskaner (default) timeline even though the aldgate-flats+mews alert is open. Consider surfacing all-branch alerts or auto-selecting the property with open alerts.

pa-key-anomaly-{id} rendering scoped to active property's usage; when 'All Branches' active, badge for aldgate-flats key not shown (usage query hits properties[0]). Same pattern as above — panel should either aggregate across properties for super-admin or force selection.

action_items: (nice-to-have) Super Admin panels (PA keys, PMS Connect Hub) should not silently fall back to properties[0] when active branch is 'all' — either aggregate or prompt user to pick a property. This will make anomaly badge and sync-alert banner discoverable to admins operating multi-property tenants.

(optional) partner_ops.py _send: consider computing sign_payload(secret, body, ts) once into a variable rather than inline in the dict — current code is correct (single call) but a local variable improves readability.
critical_code_review_comments: partner_ops.sign_payload: HMAC-SHA256 over `f'{ts}.' + body`, serialize_payload uses sort_keys=True + separators=(',',':') — deterministic. _send serializes once and passes same body to httpx.post as `content=body`, so signature matches partner side. ✅
public_api_v1.verify_sig: body is decoded from `str(data.get('body') or '')` — partners must send raw string (not JSON re-serialized). Documented in webhook_signature.note. ✅

public_api_v1.key_usage anomaly window: uses dates[-8:-1] (7 days before today) as baseline — correct with days=30; but if days<8 baseline would be empty and factor uses max(avg,1)=1, so any key with today>=20 flags. Not a bug for spec (days=30) but worth documenting when days is small.

pms_connect._push: on live success clears open alerts (update_many resolved_at). MOCK push does NOT resolve — matches spec: 'başarılı push kapatır' where başarılı = live success. ✅ (Verified in test_7_mocked_push_does_not_resolve).

pms_connect.check_sync_alert: iterates recent (threshold N) live logs; breaks on first non-fail. Correct. Emails limited to 10 recipients (cfg emails first, else admin/manager fallback). Idempotency via existing open alert lookup. ✅

be_gaps._geo_meta: caches on properties.geo_meta with sig 'v7:lat,lng'; incomplete lookup sets retry_after=+1h and does not persist sig — good self-healing on 429. Sequential await per property still a p95 concern for cold cache (see iter634 note).

success_rate.frontend: chain-search 100%, PA keys 90% (chart/docs OK, anomaly badge blocked by branch scoping), PMS sync UI not directly verified in browser (backend confirmed)
